title: Import contacts for Serve
body:
Elected officials keep the people they actually serve (newsletter subscribers, meeting sign-ins, ward event emails) in spreadsheets, and GoodParty had no way to take that list or to hold an email for anyone. This adds Import contacts for Serve: upload a CSV, match each row to someone in the constituent data or add them as a new person, review only the rows we are unsure about, and see where each contact detail came from.

Design: [TDD](https://app.clickup.com/90132012119/v/dc/2ky4jq2q-20493/2ky4jq2q-158973) and [Implementation Notes](https://app.clickup.com/90132012119/v/dc/2ky4jq2q-20493/2ky4jq2q-158993); ticket [Import contacts](https://app.clickup.com/t/86akf3ex5).

Why it is built this way:

- **Postgres is the record, Databricks only reads.** Uploads and matches live in `contact_upload` and `contact_upload_match`. Databricks reads them live through Lakehouse Federation (#3270) via dbt views, so an imported person is visible on the next read, not the next dbt run.
- **One read seam instead of a change per feature.** Every people read already takes its table from `resolveDistrict`. For orgs with the flag on, that table becomes the district's L2 rows joined to the org's overlay, so door knocking, phone banking, texting, lists, civic panel, priorities and the Serve agents see imported people without their own changes. A single org-keyed Databricks view was measured at about twice today's read time, so gp-api writes the join with the district as a literal. Both calls are recorded in `docs/adr/`.
- **Matching never guesses.** Name plus a phone or address matches automatically; everything else goes to review, with bulk accept for lone likely matches. It runs as one Databricks statement per 20,000 rows, one chunk per queue message, so a 100,000-row file stays inside the queue's visibility timeout.

Ships dark behind `serve-import-contacts` (Serve orgs only, evaluated for the org owner, 0% in dev and prod). Not in this PR, deliberately: clearing opt-outs on upload (pending a decision on text opt-outs), route alerts for `/v1/contact-uploads` (the Loki series cap; the split is a separate PR), and S3 cleanup when an org is deleted.

Merge order: gp-terraform-dataplatform#89 (dbt Cloud read grant), then this PR (creates the tables), then gp-data-platform#1282 (the overlay views). Flagging an org on before #1282 builds its views would fail that org's people reads.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **High Risk**
> Changes core person identity, federated Databricks reads on every people query for flagged orgs, and a large matching pipeline touching Postgres, SQS, and voter SQL—misconfiguration or overlay lag would break constituent reads org-wide.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds **Import contacts** for Serve orgs behind `serve-import-contacts`: multipart CSV upload, async matching (Postgres + chunked SQS + Databricks), review APIs for ambiguous rows, per-field **sources** on the person panel, and `CONTACT_IMPORT` on the activity feed. Unmatched or user-chosen **new** rows get **gp-api-minted UUID `personId`s** stored on `contact_upload_match`, treated like L2 ids everywhere else.
> 
> **People reads** no longer use a plain mart table when the flag is on: `PeopleDataset` becomes `{ base, overlayOrgSlug?, overlayDistrictId? }`, and `resolveDistrict` / agent SQL builders **FULL OUTER JOIN** the org’s federated `gp_api_contact_overlay` (and `serve_agent_contact_overlay` for CoS) at query time so lists, outreach, civic panel, and agents see imports immediately. Person payloads gain **`email`** and **`isNewContact`**.
> 
> Infra adds a private **`CONTACT_UPLOADS_BUCKET`**, overlay view env vars, Prisma `contact_upload*` tables, contracts/schemas, product-map copy, and ADRs for minted ids and read-time joins. Route alerts for `contact-uploads` are deferred (Loki cap).
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 04876c99e61b488131c439f2054ec9a5040f4362. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>

@@ -0,0 +1,215 @@
+import { z } from 'zod'
+
+export const SERVE_IMPORT_CONTACTS_FLAG = 'serve-import-contacts'
+
+export const CONTACT_UPLOAD_MAX_ROWS = 100_000
+export const CONTACT_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024
+export const CONTACT_UPLOAD_NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 60
+
+export const CONTACT_UPLOAD_FIELDS = [
+  'firstName',
+  'lastName',
+  'email',
+  'cellPhone',
+  'landline',
+  'addressLine',
+  'city',
+  'zip',
+] as const
+export type ContactUploadField = (typeof CONTACT_UPLOAD_FIELDS)[number]
+
+export const ContactUploadColumnMappingSchema = z.object({
+  firstName: z.string().min(1),
+  lastName: z.string().min(1),
+  email: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
+  cellPhone: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
+  landline: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
+  addressLine: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
+  city: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
+  zip: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
+})
+export type ContactUploadColumnMapping = z.infer<
+  typeof ContactUploadColumnMappingSchema
+>
+
+// Multipart fields sent beside the `file` part. columnMapping travels as a
+// JSON string because multipart fields are flat.
+export const CreateContactUploadFieldsSchema = z.object({
+  name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(CONTACT_UPLOAD_NAME_MAX_LENGTH),
+  consentAffirmed: z.literal('true'),
+  columnMapping: z
+    .string()
+    .transform((value, ctx) => {
+      try {
+        return JSON.parse(value) as unknown
+      } catch {
+        ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', message: 'columnMapping is not JSON' })
+        return z.NEVER
+      }
+    })
+    .pipe(ContactUploadColumnMappingSchema),
+})
+export type CreateContactUploadFields = z.input<
+  typeof CreateContactUploadFieldsSchema
+>
+
+export const ContactUploadStatusSchema = z.enum([
+  'processing',
+  'needs_input',
+  'complete',
+  'failed',
+])
+export type ContactUploadStatus = z.infer<typeof ContactUploadStatusSchema>
+
+export const ContactUploadMatchOutcomeSchema = z.enum([
+  'pending',
+  'matched',
+  'new',
+  'needs_input',
+  'resolved',
+  'skipped',
+  'invalid',
+])
+export type ContactUploadMatchOutcome = z.infer<
+  typeof ContactUploadMatchOutcomeSchema
+>
+
+export const ContactUploadSchema = z.object({
+  id: z.string(),
+  createdAt: z.string(),
+  name: z.string(),
+  fileName: z.string(),
+  uploadedBy: z
+    .object({ id: z.number(), name: z.string().nullable() })
+    .nullable(),
+  status: ContactUploadStatusSchema,
+  columnMapping: ContactUploadColumnMappingSchema,
+  rowCount: z.number(),
+  matchedCount: z.number(),
+  newCount: z.number(),
+  needsInputCount: z.number(),
+  skippedCount: z.number(),
+  invalidCount: z.number(),
+  updatedCount: z.number(),
+  unchangedCount: z.number(),
+  completedAt: z.string().nullable(),
+  failureReason: z.string().nullable(),
+})
+export type ContactUpload = z.infer<typeof ContactUploadSchema>
+
+export const ListContactUploadsResponseSchema = z.object({
+  uploads: z.array(ContactUploadSchema),
+})
+export type ListContactUploadsResponse = z.infer<
+  typeof ListContactUploadsResponseSchema
+>
+
+export const ContactUploadCandidateSchema = z.object({
+  personId: z.string(),
+  firstName: z.string().nullable(),
+  lastName: z.string().nullable(),
+  addressLine: z.string().nullable(),
+  city: z.string().nullable(),
+  zip: z.string().nullable(),
+  age: z.number().nullable(),
+})
+export type ContactUploadCandidate = z.infer<
+  typeof ContactUploadCandidateSchema
+>
+
+export const ContactUploadRowSchema = z.object({
+  id: z.string(),
+  rowIndex: z.number(),
+  firstName: z.string().nullable(),
+  lastName: z.string().nullable(),
+  email: z.string().nullable(),
+  cellPhone: z.string().nullable(),
+  landline: z.string().nullable(),
+  addressLine: z.string().nullable(),
+  city: z.string().nullable(),
+  zip: z.string().nullable(),
+  outcome: ContactUploadMatchOutcomeSchema,
+  personId: z.string().nullable(),
+  isNewPerson: z.boolean(),
+  changedFields: z.array(z.string()),
+  // Filled only for rows that need input: the people the user can pick from.
+  candidates: z.array(ContactUploadCandidateSchema),
+  suggestedPersonId: z.string().nullable(),
+})
+export type ContactUploadRow = z.infer<typeof ContactUploadRowSchema>
+
+export const ListContactUploadRowsQuerySchema = z.object({
+  outcome: z
+    .enum(['needs_input', 'processed', 'skipped', 'invalid'])
+    .default('processed'),
+  search: z.string().trim().max(200).optional(),
+  cursor: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).optional(),
+  take: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(50),
+})
+export type ListContactUploadRowsQuery = z.input<
+  typeof ListContactUploadRowsQuerySchema
+>
+
+export const ListContactUploadRowsResponseSchema = z.object({
+  rows: z.array(ContactUploadRowSchema),
+  nextCursor: z.number().nullable(),
+  total: z.number(),
+})
+export type ListContactUploadRowsResponse = z.infer<
+  typeof ListContactUploadRowsResponseSchema
+>
+
+// z.guid(), not z.uuid(): L2 person ids are uuid-shaped hashes that do not
+// carry an RFC version, which z.uuid() rejects.
+export const SetContactUploadRowMatchSchema = z.union([
+  z.object({ personId: z.guid() }),
+  z.object({ newPerson: z.literal(true) }),
+  z.object({ skip: z.literal(true) }),
+])
+export type SetContactUploadRowMatch = z.infer<
+  typeof SetContactUploadRowMatchSchema
+>
+
+export const AcceptSuggestedMatchesResponseSchema = z.object({
+  accepted: z.number(),
+  upload: ContactUploadSchema,
+})
+export type AcceptSuggestedMatchesResponse = z.infer<
+  typeof AcceptSuggestedMatchesResponseSchema
+>
+
+export const ContactFieldSourceSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
+  z.object({ kind: z.literal('constituent_file') }),
+  z.object({
+    kind: z.literal('upload'),
+    uploadId: z.string(),
+    uploadName: z.string(),
+    uploadedAt: z.string(),
+  }),
+])
+export type ContactFieldSource = z.infer<typeof ContactFieldSourceSchema>
+
+// Where each contact detail on the person panel came from, plus the upload
+// rows pointing at this person (for Change match).
+export const ContactSourcesResponseSchema = z.object({
+  fields: z.object({
+    email: ContactFieldSourceSchema.nullable(),
+    cellPhone: ContactFieldSourceSchema.nullable(),
+    landline: ContactFieldSourceSchema.nullable(),
+    address: ContactFieldSourceSchema.nullable(),
+  }),
+  uploadRows: z.array(
+    z.object({
+      rowId: z.string(),
+      uploadId: z.string(),
+      uploadName: z.string(),
+      uploadedAt: z.string(),
+    }),
+  ),
+  // Notes, statuses, interactions or outreach recorded against this person:
+  // Change match does not carry them to the new person.
+  hasActivity: z.boolean(),
+})
+export type ContactSourcesResponse = z.infer<
+  typeof ContactSourcesResponseSchema
+>

diff --git a/packages/gp-api/prisma/schema/contactUpload.prisma b/packages/gp-api/prisma/schema/contactUpload.prisma

@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+enum ContactUploadStatus {
+  processing
+  needs_input
+  complete
+  failed
+}
+
+enum ContactUploadMatchOutcome {
+  pending
+  matched
+  new
+  needs_input
+  resolved
+  skipped
+  invalid
+}
+
+enum ContactUploadMatchMethod {
+  prior_upload
+  name_and_phone
+  name_and_address
+  manual
+}
+
+/// One CSV a Serve user imported (src/contactUploads/AGENTS.md). The original
+/// file is kept in CONTACT_UPLOADS_BUCKET at fileKey; Postgres holds only the
+/// mapped columns, one ContactUploadMatch per CSV row.
+model ContactUpload {
+  id                   String               @id @default(uuid(7))
+  createdAt            DateTime             @default(now()) @map("created_at")
+  updatedAt            DateTime             @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
+  organizationSlug     String               @map("organization_slug")
+  organization         Organization         @relation(fields: [organizationSlug], references: [slug], onDelete: Cascade)
+  userId               Int?                 @map("user_id")
+  user                 User?                @relation("ContactUploadUser", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
+  name                 String
+  fileName             String               @map("file_name")
+  fileKey              String               @map("file_key")
+  /// The CSV header the user picked for each field; null when unmapped. The
+  /// wizard pre-fills from the org's latest upload with the same headers.
+  firstNameColumn      String               @map("first_name_column")
+  lastNameColumn       String               @map("last_name_column")
+  emailColumn          String?              @map("email_column")
+  cellPhoneColumn      String?              @map("cell_phone_column")
+  landlineColumn       String?              @map("landline_column")
+  addressLineColumn    String?              @map("address_line_column")
+  cityColumn           String?              @map("city_column")
+  zipColumn            String?              @map("zip_column")
+  consentAffirmedAt    DateTime             @map("consent_affirmed_at")
+  status               ContactUploadStatus  @default(processing)
+  rowCount             Int                  @map("row_count")
+  matchedCount         Int                  @default(0) @map("matched_count")
+  newCount             Int                  @default(0) @map("new_count")
+  needsInputCount      Int                  @default(0) @map("needs_input_count")
+  skippedCount         Int                  @default(0) @map("skipped_count")
+  invalidCount         Int                  @default(0) @map("invalid_count")
+  /// Re-import summary: rows that landed on someone this org already
+  /// imported, split by whether they changed a value.
+  updatedCount         Int                  @default(0) @map("updated_count")
+  unchangedCount       Int                  @default(0) @map("unchanged_count")
+  completedAt          DateTime?            @map("completed_at")
+  failureReason        String?              @map("failure_reason")
+  matches              ContactUploadMatch[]
+
+  @@index([organizationSlug, createdAt])
+  @@map("contact_upload")
+}
+
+/// One CSV row and what it matched. personId is an L2 person id from
+/// mart_gp_api or a uuid gp-api minted for someone the voter file does not
+/// hold; Databricks reads these rows live (gp_api_contact_overlay) and folds
+/// them into every people read for the org.
+model ContactUploadMatch {
+  id                 String                    @id @default(uuid(7))
+  createdAt          DateTime                  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
+  updatedAt          DateTime                  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
+  uploadId           String                    @map("upload_id")
+  upload             ContactUpload             @relation(fields: [uploadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+  /// Denormalized from the upload so the overlay view filters one table.
+  organizationSlug   String                    @map("organization_slug")
+  rowIndex           Int                       @map("row_index")
+  firstName          String?                   @map("first_name")
+  lastName           String?                   @map("last_name")
+  /// Lowercased.
+  email              String?
+  /// "(616) 555-0142", the L2 format every outreach channel already reads.
+  cellPhone          String?                   @map("cell_phone")
+  landline           String?
+  addressLine        String?                   @map("address_line")
+  city               String?
+  /// Five digits.
+  zip                String?
+  outcome            ContactUploadMatchOutcome @default(pending)
+  method             ContactUploadMatchMethod?
+  /// Null unless the outcome is matched, new or resolved.
+  personId           String?                   @map("person_id")
+  isNewPerson        Boolean                   @default(false) @map("is_new_person")
+  /// Up to 10 L2 people the user can pick from in review.
+  candidatePersonIds String[]                  @default([]) @map("candidate_person_ids")
+  /// The one person who shares the name but nothing else; accepted in bulk.
+  suggestedPersonId  String?                   @map("suggested_person_id")
+  /// Re-import: the fields this row changed on someone already imported.
+  changedFields      String[]                  @default([]) @map("changed_fields")
+  resolvedAt         DateTime?                 @map("resolved_at")
+  resolvedByUserId   Int?                      @map("resolved_by_user_id")
+  resolvedBy         User?                     @relation("ContactUploadMatchResolvedBy", fields: [resolvedByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
+
+  @@unique([uploadId, rowIndex])
+  @@index([uploadId, outcome, rowIndex])
+  @@index([organizationSlug, personId])
+  @@index([organizationSlug, email])
+  @@index([organizationSlug, cellPhone])
+  @@index([organizationSlug, landline])
+  @@map("contact_upload_match")
+}

+import {
+  Controller,
+  Get,
+  NotFoundException,
+  Param,
+  UseInterceptors,
+  UsePipes,
+} from '@nestjs/common'
+import {
+  ContactSourcesResponseSchema,
+  SERVE_IMPORT_CONTACTS_FLAG,
+} from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { ZodValidationPipe } from 'nestjs-zod'
+import { Organization } from '@/generated/prisma'
+import { ReqOrganization } from '@/organizations/decorators/ReqOrganization.decorator'
+import { UseOrganization } from '@/organizations/decorators/UseOrganization.decorator'
+import { FeaturesService } from '@/features/services/features.service'
+import { ResponseSchema } from '@/shared/decorators/ResponseSchema.decorator'
+import { ZodResponseInterceptor } from '@/shared/interceptors/ZodResponse.interceptor'
+import { ContactSourcesParamsDTO } from './schemas/contactUploadParams.schema'
+import { ContactUploadMatchService } from './services/contactUploadMatch.service'
+
+// Lives beside the uploads rather than in ContactsController because every
+// answer comes from upload rows in Postgres.
+@Controller('contacts')
+@UseOrganization()
+@UsePipes(ZodValidationPipe)
+@UseInterceptors(ZodResponseInterceptor)
+export class ContactSourcesController {
+  constructor(
+    private readonly matches: ContactUploadMatchService,
+    private readonly features: FeaturesService,
+  ) {}
+
+  @Get(':personId/sources')
+  @ResponseSchema(ContactSourcesResponseSchema)
+  async getSources(
+    @ReqOrganization() organization: Organization,
+    @Param() { personId }: ContactSourcesParamsDTO,
+  ) {
+    const enabled =
+      organization.slug.startsWith('eo-') &&
+      (await this.features.isFeatureEnabled({
+        user: organization.ownerId,
+        feature: SERVE_IMPORT_CONTACTS_FLAG,
+      }))
+    if (!enabled) throw new NotFoundException()
+    return this.matches.sourcesFor(organization, personId.toLowerCase())
+  }
+}

+import {
+  BadRequestException,
+  Body,
+  Controller,
+  Get,
+  HttpCode,
+  HttpStatus,
+  NotFoundException,
+  Param,
+  Post,
+  Put,
+  Query,
+  UseInterceptors,
+  UsePipes,
+} from '@nestjs/common'
+import {
+  AcceptSuggestedMatchesResponseSchema,
+  CONTACT_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES,
+  ContactUploadSchema,
+  CreateContactUploadFieldsSchema,
+  ListContactUploadRowsQuerySchema,
+  ListContactUploadRowsResponseSchema,
+  ListContactUploadsResponseSchema,
+  SERVE_IMPORT_CONTACTS_FLAG,
+  SetContactUploadRowMatchSchema,
+  type SetContactUploadRowMatch,
+} from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { ZodValidationPipe } from 'nestjs-zod'
+import { z } from 'zod'
+import { Organization, User } from '@/generated/prisma'
+import { ReqUser } from '@/authentication/decorators/ReqUser.decorator'
+import { ReqOrganization } from '@/organizations/decorators/ReqOrganization.decorator'
+import { UseOrganization } from '@/organizations/decorators/UseOrganization.decorator'
+import { ReqFile } from '@/files/decorators/ReqFiles.decorator'
+import { FileUpload } from '@/files/files.types'
+import { FilesInterceptor } from '@/files/interceptors/files.interceptor'
+import { FeaturesService } from '@/features/services/features.service'
+import { ResponseSchema } from '@/shared/decorators/ResponseSchema.decorator'
+import { ZodResponseInterceptor } from '@/shared/interceptors/ZodResponse.interceptor'
+import {
+  ContactUploadParamsDTO,
+  ContactUploadRowParamsDTO,
+} from './schemas/contactUploadParams.schema'
+import { ContactUploadsService } from './services/contactUploads.service'
+
+@Controller('contact-uploads')
+@UseOrganization()
+@UsePipes(ZodValidationPipe)
+@UseInterceptors(ZodResponseInterceptor)
+export class ContactUploadsController {
+  constructor(
+    private readonly uploads: ContactUploadsService,
+    private readonly features: FeaturesService,
+  ) {}
+
+  @Post()
+  @UseInterceptors(
+    FilesInterceptor('file', {
+      mode: 'buffer',
+      sizeLimit: CONTACT_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES,
+    }),
+  )
+  @ResponseSchema(ContactUploadSchema)
+  async createUpload(
+    @ReqOrganization() organization: Organization,
+    @ReqUser() user: User,
+    @Body(new ZodValidationPipe(CreateContactUploadFieldsSchema))
+    fields: z.output<typeof CreateContactUploadFieldsSchema>,
+    @ReqFile() file?: FileUpload,
+  ) {
+    await this.assertImportContactsOn(organization)
+    if (!file || !Buffer.isBuffer(file.data)) {
+      throw new BadRequestException('No file found')
+    }
+    return this.uploads.createUpload({
+      organization,
+      userId: user.id,
+      name: fields.name,
+      columnMapping: fields.columnMapping,
+      fileName: file.filename,
+      file: file.data,
+    })
+  }
+
+  @Get()
+  @ResponseSchema(ListContactUploadsResponseSchema)
+  async listUploads(@ReqOrganization() organization: Organization) {
+    await this.assertImportContactsOn(organization)
+    return this.uploads.listUploads(organization)
+  }
+
+  @Get(':id')
+  @ResponseSchema(ContactUploadSchema)
+  async getUpload(
+    @ReqOrganization() organization: Organization,
+    @Param() { id }: ContactUploadParamsDTO,
+  ) {
+    await this.assertImportContactsOn(organization)
+    return this.uploads.getUpload(organization, id)
+  }
+
+  @Get(':id/rows')
+  @ResponseSchema(ListContactUploadRowsResponseSchema)
+  async listRows(
+    @ReqOrganization() organization: Organization,
+    @Param() { id }: ContactUploadParamsDTO,
+    @Query(new ZodValidationPipe(ListContactUploadRowsQuerySchema))
+    query: z.output<typeof ListContactUploadRowsQuerySchema>,
+  ) {
+    await this.assertImportContactsOn(organization)
+    return this.uploads.listRows(organization, id, query)
+  }
+
+  @Put(':id/rows/:rowId/match')
+  @ResponseSchema(ContactUploadSchema)
+  async setRowMatch(
+    @ReqOrganization() organization: Organization,
+    @ReqUser() user: User,
+    @Param() { id, rowId }: ContactUploadRowParamsDTO,
+    @Body(new ZodValidationPipe(SetContactUploadRowMatchSchema))
+    body: SetContactUploadRowMatch,
+  ) {
+    await this.assertImportContactsOn(organization)
+    return this.uploads.setRowMatch({
+      organization,
+      uploadId: id,
+      rowId,
+      userId: user.id,
+      body,
+    })
+  }
+
+  @Post(':id/accept-suggested')
+  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
+  @ResponseSchema(AcceptSuggestedMatchesResponseSchema)
+  async acceptSuggested(
+    @ReqOrganization() organization: Organization,
+    @ReqUser() user: User,
+    @Param() { id }: ContactUploadParamsDTO,
+  ) {
+    await this.assertImportContactsOn(organization)
+    return this.uploads.acceptSuggested({
+      organization,
+      uploadId: id,
+      userId: user.id,
+    })
+  }
+
+  @Post(':id/retry')
+  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
+  @ResponseSchema(ContactUploadSchema)
+  async retryUpload(
+    @ReqOrganization() organization: Organization,
+    @Param() { id }: ContactUploadParamsDTO,
+  ) {
+    await this.assertImportContactsOn(organization)
+    return this.uploads.retryUpload(organization, id)
+  }
+
+  // Serve only, and rolled out per org: the flag follows the org's owner.
+  private async assertImportContactsOn(
+    organization: Organization,
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    const enabled =
+      organization.slug.startsWith('eo-') &&
+      (await this.features.isFeatureEnabled({
+        user: organization.ownerId,
+        feature: SERVE_IMPORT_CONTACTS_FLAG,
+      }))
+    if (!enabled) throw new NotFoundException()
+  }
+}

+import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'
+import type {
+  ContactFieldSource,
+  ContactSourcesResponse,
+} from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import {
+  ContactUploadMatchOutcome,
+  Organization,
+  Prisma,
+} from '@/generated/prisma'
+import { createPrismaBase, MODELS } from '@/prisma/util/prisma.util'
+
+// The rows that make an upload row part of a person: matched or added when
+// the upload ran, or picked by hand in review.
+export const PERSON_OUTCOMES = [
+  ContactUploadMatchOutcome.matched,
+  ContactUploadMatchOutcome.new,
+  ContactUploadMatchOutcome.resolved,
+]
+
+const FEED_INCLUDE = {
+  upload: { select: { id: true, name: true, createdAt: true } },
+  resolvedBy: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
+} satisfies Prisma.ContactUploadMatchInclude
+
+export type ContactUploadMatchForFeed = Prisma.ContactUploadMatchGetPayload<{
+  include: typeof FEED_INCLUDE
+}>
+
+@Injectable()
+export class ContactUploadMatchService extends createPrismaBase(
+  MODELS.ContactUploadMatch,
+) {
+  // Every upload row pointing at this person. Unbounded on purpose: a person
+  // has at most one row per upload in practice, so the person feed takes the
+  // whole set rather than windowing it like the interaction channels.
+  async findForActivityFeed(
+    organizationSlug: string,
+    personId: string,
+  ): Promise<ContactUploadMatchForFeed[]> {
+    return this.model.findMany({
+      where: { organizationSlug, personId, outcome: { in: PERSON_OUTCOMES } },
+      include: FEED_INCLUDE,
+      orderBy: { id: Prisma.SortOrder.desc },
+    })
+  }
+
+  async sourcesFor(
+    organization: Organization,
+    personId: string,
+  ): Promise<ContactSourcesResponse> {
+    const rows = await this.model.findMany({
+      where: {
+        organizationSlug: organization.slug,
+        personId,
+        outcome: { in: PERSON_OUTCOMES },
+      },
+      include: {
+        upload: { select: { id: true, name: true, createdAt: true } },
+      },
+      orderBy: [
+        { upload: { createdAt: Prisma.SortOrder.desc } },
+        { rowIndex: Prisma.SortOrder.desc },
+      ],
+    })
+    // A person gp-api minted has no constituent file behind the fields no
+    // upload supplied.
+    const fallback: ContactFieldSource | null = rows.some(
+      (row) => row.isNewPerson,
+    )
+      ? null
+      : { kind: 'constituent_file' }
+    const sourceOf = (
+      supplied: (row: (typeof rows)[number]) => boolean,
+    ): ContactFieldSource | null => {
+      const row = rows.find(supplied)
+      return row
+        ? {
+            kind: 'upload',
+            uploadId: row.upload.id,
+            uploadName: row.upload.name,
+            uploadedAt: row.upload.createdAt.toISOString(),
+          }
+        : fallback
+    }
+    const [activity] = await this.client.$queryRaw<{ exists: boolean }[]>`
+      SELECT (
+        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_note
+          WHERE organization_slug = ${organization.slug}
+            AND person_id = ${personId})
+        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_status_event
+          WHERE organization_slug = ${organization.slug}
+            AND person_id = ${personId})
+        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_interaction_door_knock
+          WHERE organization_slug = ${organization.slug}
+            AND person_id = ${personId})
+        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_interaction_text
+          WHERE organization_slug = ${organization.slug}
+            AND person_id = ${personId})
+        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_interaction_robocall
+          WHERE organization_slug = ${organization.slug}
+            AND person_id = ${personId})
+        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_interaction_phone_banking
+          WHERE organization_slug = ${organization.slug}
+            AND person_id = ${personId})
+        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach_text_recipient
+          WHERE organization_slug = ${organization.slug}
+            AND person_id = ${personId})
+      ) AS "exists"
+    `
+    return {
+      fields: {
+        email: sourceOf((row) => row.email !== null),
+        cellPhone: sourceOf((row) => row.cellPhone !== null),
+        landline: sourceOf((row) => row.landline !== null),
+        address: sourceOf((row) => row.addressLine !== null),
+      },
+      uploadRows: rows.map((row) => ({
+        rowId: row.id,
+        uploadId: row.upload.id,
+        uploadName: row.upload.name,
+        uploadedAt: row.upload.createdAt.toISOString(),
+      })),
+      hasActivity: activity?.exists ?? false,
+    }
+  }
+}

+import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'
+import { CONTACT_UPLOAD_FIELDS } from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { v7 as uuidv7 } from 'uuid'
+import {
+  ContactUpload,
+  ContactUploadMatch,
+  ContactUploadMatchMethod,
+  ContactUploadMatchOutcome,
+  ContactUploadStatus,
+  Organization,
+  Prisma,
+} from '@/generated/prisma'
+import { createPrismaBase, MODELS } from '@/prisma/util/prisma.util'
+import { ContactsService } from '@/contacts/services/contacts.service'
+import { VoterQueryService } from '@/peopleDb/services/voterQuery.service'
+import type { PeopleDataset } from '@/peopleDb/services/peopleDataset.service'
+import type {
+  ContactUploadMatchCandidateRow,
+  ContactUploadMatchInputRow,
+} from '@/peopleDb/databricks/contactUploadMatchSql.util'
+import { AnalyticsService } from '@/analytics/analytics.service'
+import { QueueProducerService } from '@/queue/producer/queueProducer.service'
+import { MessageGroup, QueueType } from '@/queue/queue.types'
+import { EVENTS } from '@/vendors/segment/segment.types'
+import {
+  addressParts,
+  decideFromCandidates,
+  nameKey,
+  type MatchDecision,
+} from '../util/contactUploadMatching.util'
+import { ContactUploadsService } from './contactUploads.service'
+
+export const MATCH_CHUNK_SIZE = 20_000
+
+// The main queue's redrive maxReceiveCount (deploy/index.ts). The delivery
+// that reaches it is the last one, so it marks the upload failed instead of
+// handing the message to the DLQ with the upload still `processing`.
+export const CONTACT_UPLOAD_MATCH_MAX_RECEIVES = 3
+
+const FAILURE_REASON = 'Matching did not finish'
+
+type KeyedRow = {
+  row: ContactUploadMatch
+  firstKey: string
+  lastKey: string
+  house: string | null
+  streetKey: string | null
+}
+
+type PriorRow = {
+  personId: string
+  isNewPerson: boolean
+  firstName: string | null
+  lastName: string | null
+  email: string | null
+  cellPhone: string | null
+  landline: string | null
+  addressLine: string | null
+  zip: string | null
+}
+
+type OverlayRow = Pick<
+  ContactUploadMatch,
+  | 'personId'
+  | 'firstName'
+  | 'lastName'
+  | 'email'
+  | 'cellPhone'
+  | 'landline'
+  | 'addressLine'
+  | 'city'
+  | 'zip'
+>
+
+const phoneKeys = (keyed: KeyedRow): string[] =>
+  keyed.lastKey === ''
+    ? []
+    : [keyed.row.cellPhone, keyed.row.landline]
+        .filter((phone): phone is string => phone !== null)
+        .map((phone) => `${phone}|${keyed.lastKey}`)
+
+const nameAddressKey = (
+  firstKey: string,
+  lastKey: string,
+  house: string | null,
+  streetKey: string | null,
+): string | null =>
+  firstKey && lastKey && house && streetKey
+    ? `${firstKey}|${lastKey}|${house}|${streetKey}`
+    : null
+
+@Injectable()
+export class ContactUploadMatchJobService extends createPrismaBase(
+  MODELS.ContactUploadMatch,
+) {
+  constructor(
+    private readonly uploads: ContactUploadsService,
+    private readonly contacts: ContactsService,
+    private readonly voterQuery: VoterQueryService,
+    private readonly analytics: AnalyticsService,
+    private readonly queueProducer: QueueProducerService,
+  ) {
+    super()
+  }
+
+  // Queue handler for QueueType.CONTACT_UPLOAD_MATCH. Returns true to ack,
+  // false to let SQS redeliver. Each delivery matches one chunk and, while
+  // pending rows remain, queues the next before acking, so no delivery
+  // outlives the visibility timeout. Only `pending` rows are worked, so a
+  // redelivery resumes where the last one stopped.
+  async handleQueuedMatch(
+    uploadId: string,
+    receiveCount: number,
+  ): Promise<boolean> {
+    const upload = await this.client.contactUpload.findFirst({
+      where: { id: uploadId, status: ContactUploadStatus.processing },
+      include: { organization: true },
+    })
+    if (!upload) {
+      this.logger.info(
+        { uploadId },
+        'contactUploadMatch: upload is not processing; acking',
+      )
+      return true
+    }
+
+    let failed = false
+    try {
+      await this.matchNextChunk(upload, upload.organization)
+    } catch (err) {
+      const lastAttempt = receiveCount >= CONTACT_UPLOAD_MATCH_MAX_RECEIVES
+      this.logger.error(
+        { err, uploadId, receiveCount, lastAttempt },
+        'contactUploadMatch: matching failed',
+      )
+      if (!lastAttempt) return false
+      failed = true
+    }
+    if (failed) {
+      await this.client.contactUpload.updateMany({
+        where: { id: uploadId, status: ContactUploadStatus.processing },
+        data: {
+          status: ContactUploadStatus.failed,
+          failureReason: FAILURE_REASON,
+        },
+      })
+    }
+    return true
+  }
+
+  private async matchNextChunk(
+    upload: ContactUpload,
+    organization: Organization,
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    const rows = await this.model.findMany({
+      where: {
+        uploadId: upload.id,
+        outcome: ContactUploadMatchOutcome.pending,
+      },
+      orderBy: { rowIndex: Prisma.SortOrder.asc },
+      take: MATCH_CHUNK_SIZE,
+    })
+    if (rows.length > 0) {
+      const { districtId, dataset } =
+        await this.contacts.resolveEligibleDistrict(organization)
+      await this.matchChunk(upload, rows, districtId, dataset)
+    }
+
+    const nextPending = await this.model.findFirst({
+      where: {
+        uploadId: upload.id,
+        outcome: ContactUploadMatchOutcome.pending,
+      },
+      orderBy: { rowIndex: Prisma.SortOrder.asc },
+      select: { rowIndex: true },
+    })
+    if (nextPending) {
+      await this.queueProducer.sendMessage(
+        { type: QueueType.CONTACT_UPLOAD_MATCH, data: { uploadId: upload.id } },
+        `${MessageGroup.contactUploadMatch}-${upload.organizationSlug}`,
+        {
+          throwOnError: true,
+          deduplicationId: `${QueueType.CONTACT_UPLOAD_MATCH}-${upload.id}-${nextPending.rowIndex}`,
+        },
+      )
+      this.logger.info(
+        {
+          uploadId: upload.id,
+          chunkRows: rows.length,
+          nextRowIndex: nextPending.rowIndex,
+        },
+        'contactUploadMatch: chunk done; queued the next',
+      )
+      return
+    }
+
+    const finished = await this.client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      const counts = await this.uploads.countOutcomes(tx, upload.id)
+      const needsInput = counts.needsInputCount > 0
+      return tx.contactUpload.update({
+        where: { id: upload.id },
+        data: {
+          ...counts,
+          status: needsInput
+            ? ContactUploadStatus.needs_input
+            : ContactUploadStatus.complete,
+          completedAt: needsInput ? null : new Date(),
+          failureReason: null,
+        },
+      })
+    })
+
+    this.logger.info(
+      {
+        uploadId: upload.id,
+        rowCount: finished.rowCount,
+        chunkRows: rows.length,
+        matchedCount: finished.matchedCount,
+        newCount: finished.newCount,
+        needsInputCount: finished.needsInputCount,
+        skippedCount: finished.skippedCount,
+        invalidCount: finished.invalidCount,
+        updatedCount: finished.updatedCount,
+        unchangedCount: finished.unchangedCount,
+      },
+      'contactUploadMatch: done',
+    )
+
+    if (finished.userId !== null) {
+      const [gained] = await this.client.$queryRaw<{ count: number }[]>`
+        SELECT count(DISTINCT m.person_id)::int AS count
+        FROM contact_upload_match m
+        WHERE m.upload_id = ${upload.id}
+          AND m.email IS NOT NULL
+          AND m.person_id IS NOT NULL
+          AND NOT EXISTS (
+            SELECT 1 FROM contact_upload_match p
+            WHERE p.organization_slug = m.organization_slug
+              AND p.person_id = m.person_id
+              AND p.upload_id <> m.upload_id
+              AND p.email = m.email
+          )
+      `
+      const earlierUploads = await this.client.contactUpload.count({
+        where: {
+          organizationSlug: upload.organizationSlug,
+          createdAt: { lt: upload.createdAt },
+        },
+      })
+      void this.analytics
+        .track(finished.userId, EVENTS.Contacts.ImportCompleted, {
+          uploadId: upload.id,
+          rowCount: finished.rowCount,
+          matchedCount: finished.matchedCount,
+          newCount: finished.newCount,
+          ambiguousCount: finished.needsInputCount,
+          emailsGained: gained?.count ?? 0,
+          isReimport: earlierUploads > 0,
+        })
+        .catch(() => undefined)
+    }
+  }
+
+  private async matchChunk(
+    upload: ContactUpload,
+    rows: ContactUploadMatch[],
+    districtId: string,
+    dataset: PeopleDataset,
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    const keyed: KeyedRow[] = rows.map((row) => ({
+      row,
+      firstKey: nameKey(row.firstName),
+      lastKey: nameKey(row.lastName),
+      ...addressParts(row.addressLine),
+    }))
+
+    // Within the file: a later row with an earlier row's email, or phone and
+    // last name, follows that row to whatever person it lands on.
+    const leaderOf = new Map<string, KeyedRow>()
+    const leaders: KeyedRow[] = []
+    const leaderByEmail = new Map<string, KeyedRow>()
+    const leaderByPhone = new Map<string, KeyedRow>()
+    for (const entry of keyed) {
+      const keys = phoneKeys(entry)
+      const leader =
+        (entry.row.email ? leaderByEmail.get(entry.row.email) : undefined) ??
+        keys
+          .map((key) => leaderByPhone.get(key))
+          .find((found) => found !== undefined)
+      if (leader) {
+        leaderOf.set(entry.row.id, leader)
+      } else {
+        leaders.push(entry)
+      }
+      const owner = leader ?? entry
+      if (entry.row.email && !leaderByEmail.has(entry.row.email)) {
+        leaderByEmail.set(entry.row.email, owner)
+      }
+      for (const key of keys) {
+        if (!leaderByPhone.has(key)) leaderByPhone.set(key, owner)
+      }
+    }
+
+    const decisions = new Map<string, MatchDecision>()
+
+    // The org's earlier rows, this upload's earlier chunks included: by
+    // email, then phone and last name, then name and address.
+    const emails = [
+      ...new Set(
+        leaders
+          .map((entry) => entry.row.email)
+          .filter((email): email is string => email !== null),
+      ),
+    ]
+    const phones = [
+      ...new Set(
+        leaders.flatMap((entry) =>
+          [entry.row.cellPhone, entry.row.landline].filter(
+            (phone): phone is string => phone !== null,
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    ]
+    const lastKeys = [
+      ...new Set(leaders.map((entry) => entry.lastKey).filter(Boolean)),
+    ]
+    const prior = await this.client.$queryRaw<PriorRow[]>`
+      SELECT person_id AS "personId", is_new_person AS "isNewPerson",
+        first_name AS "firstName", last_name AS "lastName", email,
+        cell_phone AS "cellPhone", landline, address_line AS "addressLine",
+        zip
+      FROM contact_upload_match
+      WHERE organization_slug = ${upload.organizationSlug}
+        AND person_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND (
+          email = ANY(${emails}::text[])
+          OR cell_phone = ANY(${phones}::text[])
+          OR landline = ANY(${phones}::text[])
+          OR regexp_replace(lower(last_name), '[^a-z]', '', 'g')
+            = ANY(${lastKeys}::text[])
+        )
+      ORDER BY id DESC
+    `
+    const priorByEmail = new Map<string, PriorRow>()
+    const priorByPhone = new Map<string, PriorRow>()
+    const priorByNameAddress = new Map<string, PriorRow[]>()
+    for (const row of prior) {
+      const lastKey = nameKey(row.lastName)
+      if (row.email && !priorByEmail.has(row.email)) {
+        priorByEmail.set(row.email, row)
+      }
+      if (lastKey) {
+        for (const phone of [row.cellPhone, row.landline]) {
+          const key = `${phone}|${lastKey}`
+          if (phone && !priorByPhone.has(key)) priorByPhone.set(key, row)
+        }
+      }
+      const { house, streetKey } = addressParts(row.addressLine)
+      const key = nameAddressKey(
+        nameKey(row.firstName),
+        lastKey,
+        house,
+        streetKey,
+      )
+      if (key) {
+        priorByNameAddress.set(key, [
+          ...(priorByNameAddress.get(key) ?? []),
+          row,
+        ])
+      }
+    }
+
+    const toDistrict: KeyedRow[] = []
+    for (const entry of leaders) {
+      const addressKey = nameAddressKey(
+        entry.firstKey,
+        entry.lastKey,
+        entry.house,
+        entry.streetKey,
+      )
+      const hit =
+        (entry.row.email ? priorByEmail.get(entry.row.email) : undefined) ??
+        phoneKeys(entry)
+          .map((key) => priorByPhone.get(key))
+          .find((found) => found !== undefined) ??
+        (addressKey
+          ? priorByNameAddress
+              .get(addressKey)
+              ?.find(
+                (row) =>
+                  row.zip === null ||
+                  entry.row.zip === null ||
+                  row.zip === entry.row.zip,
+              )
+          : undefined)
+      if (hit) {
+        decisions.set(entry.row.id, {
+          outcome: 'matched',
+          method: ContactUploadMatchMethod.prior_upload,
+          personId: hit.personId,
+          isNewPerson: hit.isNewPerson,
+          candidatePersonIds: [],
+          suggestedPersonId: null,
+        })
+      } else if (entry.firstKey && entry.lastKey) {
+        toDistrict.push(entry)
+      }
+    }
+
+    const inputs: ContactUploadMatchInputRow[] = toDistrict.map((entry) => ({
+      rowIndex: entry.row.rowIndex,
+      firstKey: entry.firstKey,
+      lastKey: entry.lastKey,
+      cell: entry.row.cellPhone,
+      landline: entry.row.landline,
+      house: entry.house,
+      streetKey: entry.streetKey,
+      zip: entry.row.zip,
+    }))
+    const candidates =
+      inputs.length === 0
+        ? []
+        : await this.voterQuery.matchContactUploadRows(
+            districtId,
+            dataset,
+            inputs,
+          )
+    const candidatesByRow = new Map<number, ContactUploadMatchCandidateRow[]>()
+    for (const candidate of candidates) {
+      candidatesByRow.set(candidate.rowIndex, [
+        ...(candidatesByRow.get(candidate.rowIndex) ?? []),
+        candidate,
+      ])
+    }
+    for (const entry of toDistrict) {
+      const found = (candidatesByRow.get(entry.row.rowIndex) ?? []).sort(
+        (a, b) =>
+          Number(b.phoneAgrees) - Number(a.phoneAgrees) ||
+          Number(b.addressAgrees) - Number(a.addressAgrees) ||
+          a.personId.localeCompare(b.personId),
+      )
+      const decision = decideFromCandidates(found)
+      if (decision) decisions.set(entry.row.id, decision)
+    }
+
+    for (const entry of leaders) {
+      if (!decisions.has(entry.row.id)) {
+        decisions.set(entry.row.id, {
+          outcome: 'new',
+          method: null,
+          personId: uuidv7(),
+          isNewPerson: true,
+          candidatePersonIds: [],
+          suggestedPersonId: null,
+        })
+      }
+    }
+    for (const [rowId, leader] of leaderOf) {
+      const decision = decisions.get(leader.row.id)
+      if (decision) decisions.set(rowId, decision)
+    }
+
+    // Re-import: what an earlier upload already gave the person each row
+    // landed on, latest upload first, so a row's changedFields say what it
+    // changed.
+    const personIds = [
+      ...new Set(
+        [...decisions.values()]
+          .map((decision) => decision.personId)
+          .filter((id): id is string => id !== null),
+      ),
+    ]
+    const overlayRows =
+      personIds.length === 0
+        ? []
+        : await this.client.$queryRaw<OverlayRow[]>`
+            SELECT m.person_id AS "personId", m.first_name AS "firstName",
+              m.last_name AS "lastName", m.email, m.cell_phone AS "cellPhone",
+              m.landline, m.address_line AS "addressLine", m.city, m.zip
+            FROM contact_upload_match m
+            JOIN contact_upload u ON u.id = m.upload_id
+            WHERE m.organization_slug = ${upload.organizationSlug}
+              AND m.person_id = ANY(${personIds}::text[])
+              AND m.upload_id <> ${upload.id}
+            ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, m.row_index DESC
+          `
+    const overlay = new Map<string, OverlayRow>()
+    for (const row of overlayRows) {
+      if (row.personId === null) continue
+      const current = overlay.get(row.personId)
+      if (!current) {
+        overlay.set(row.personId, row)
+        continue
+      }
+      for (const field of CONTACT_UPLOAD_FIELDS) {
+        if (current[field] === null) current[field] = row[field]
+      }
+    }
+
+    const changedFieldsByRow = new Map<string, string[]>()
+    for (const { row } of keyed) {
+      const personId = decisions.get(row.id)?.personId
+      const current = personId ? overlay.get(personId) : undefined
+      if (!current) continue
+      const changed = CONTACT_UPLOAD_FIELDS.filter(
+        (field) => row[field] !== null && row[field] !== current[field],
+      )
+      changedFieldsByRow.set(row.id, changed)
+    }
+
+    const written = keyed.flatMap(({ row }) => {
+      const decision = decisions.get(row.id)
+      return decision ? [{ row, decision }] : []
+    })
+    await this.client.$executeRaw`
+        UPDATE contact_upload_match AS m
+        SET outcome = v.outcome::"ContactUploadMatchOutcome",
+            method = v.method::"ContactUploadMatchMethod",
+            person_id = v.person_id,
+            is_new_person = v.is_new_person,
+            candidate_person_ids = string_to_array(v.candidates, ','),
+            suggested_person_id = v.suggested,
+            changed_fields = string_to_array(v.changed, ','),
+            updated_at = now()
+        FROM unnest(
+          ${written.map(({ row }) => row.id)}::text[],
+          ${written.map(({ decision }) => decision.outcome)}::text[],
+          ${written.map(({ decision }) => decision.method)}::text[],
+          ${written.map(({ decision }) => decision.personId)}::text[],
+          ${written.map(({ decision }) => decision.isNewPerson)}::boolean[],
+          ${written.map(({ decision }) => decision.candidatePersonIds.join(','))}::text[],
+          ${written.map(({ decision }) => decision.suggestedPersonId)}::text[],
+          ${written.map(({ row }) => (changedFieldsByRow.get(row.id) ?? []).join(','))}::text[]
+        ) AS v(id, outcome, method, person_id, is_new_person, candidates,
+          suggested, changed)
+        WHERE m.id = v.id AND m.outcome = 'pending'
+      `
+  }
+}

+import {
+  BadGatewayException,
+  BadRequestException,
+  ConflictException,
+  Injectable,
+  NotFoundException,
+} from '@nestjs/common'
+import {
+  type AcceptSuggestedMatchesResponse,
+  type ContactUpload as ContactUploadResponse,
+  type ContactUploadCandidate,
+  type ContactUploadColumnMapping,
+  type ContactUploadRow,
+  type ListContactUploadRowsResponse,
+  type ListContactUploadsResponse,
+  type SetContactUploadRowMatch,
+} from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { MimeTypes } from 'http-constants-ts'
+import { v7 as uuidv7 } from 'uuid'
+import {
+  ContactUpload,
+  ContactUploadMatch,
+  ContactUploadMatchMethod,
+  ContactUploadMatchOutcome,
+  ContactUploadStatus,

+} from '@/generated/prisma'

+import { S3Service } from '@/vendors/aws/services/s3.service'
+import { QueueProducerService } from '@/queue/producer/queueProducer.service'
+import { MessageGroup, QueueType } from '@/queue/queue.types'
+import { ContactsService } from '@/contacts/services/contacts.service'
+import { VoterQueryService } from '@/peopleDb/services/voterQuery.service'
+import { ListPeopleDTO } from '@/peopleDb/schemas/people.schema'
+import { AnalyticsService } from '@/analytics/analytics.service'
+import { EVENTS } from '@/vendors/segment/segment.types'
+import { parseContactUploadCsv } from '../util/contactUploadCsv.util'
+import {
+  type ContactUploadCounts,
+  type ContactUploadOutcomeGroup,
+  countsFromOutcomeGroups,
+} from '../util/contactUploadCounts.util'
+
+const INSERT_CHUNK_SIZE = 5_000
+
+const UPLOAD_USER_INCLUDE = {
+  user: { select: { id: true, firstName: true, lastName: true } },
+} satisfies Prisma.ContactUploadInclude
+
+type ContactUploadWithUser = Prisma.ContactUploadGetPayload<{
+  include: typeof UPLOAD_USER_INCLUDE
+}>
+
+export type ListContactUploadRowsInput = {
+  outcome: 'needs_input' | 'processed' | 'skipped' | 'invalid'
+  search?: string
+  cursor?: number
+  take: number
+}
+
+const OUTCOMES_BY_FILTER: Record<
+  ListContactUploadRowsInput['outcome'],
+  ContactUploadMatchOutcome[]
+> = {
+  needs_input: [ContactUploadMatchOutcome.needs_input],
+  processed: [
+    ContactUploadMatchOutcome.matched,
+    ContactUploadMatchOutcome.new,
+    ContactUploadMatchOutcome.resolved,
+  ],
+  skipped: [ContactUploadMatchOutcome.skipped],
+  invalid: [ContactUploadMatchOutcome.invalid],
+}
+
+const columnMappingOf = (
+  upload: ContactUpload,
+): ContactUploadColumnMapping => ({
+  firstName: upload.firstNameColumn,
+  lastName: upload.lastNameColumn,
+  email: upload.emailColumn,
+  cellPhone: upload.cellPhoneColumn,
+  landline: upload.landlineColumn,
+  addressLine: upload.addressLineColumn,
+  city: upload.cityColumn,
+  zip: upload.zipColumn,
+})
+
+const toUploadResponse = (
+  upload: ContactUploadWithUser,
+): ContactUploadResponse => ({
+  id: upload.id,
+  createdAt: upload.createdAt.toISOString(),
+  name: upload.name,
+  fileName: upload.fileName,
+  uploadedBy: upload.user
+    ? {
+        id: upload.user.id,
+        name:
+          [upload.user.firstName, upload.user.lastName]
+            .filter(Boolean)
+            .join(' ') || null,
+      }
+    : null,
+  status: upload.status,
+  columnMapping: columnMappingOf(upload),
+  rowCount: upload.rowCount,
+  matchedCount: upload.matchedCount,
+  newCount: upload.newCount,
+  needsInputCount: upload.needsInputCount,
+  skippedCount: upload.skippedCount,
+  invalidCount: upload.invalidCount,
+  updatedCount: upload.updatedCount,
+  unchangedCount: upload.unchangedCount,
+  completedAt: upload.completedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
+  failureReason: upload.failureReason,
+})
+
+const toRowResponse = (
+  row: ContactUploadMatch,
+  candidates: ContactUploadCandidate[],
+): ContactUploadRow => ({
+  id: row.id,
+  rowIndex: row.rowIndex,
+  firstName: row.firstName,
+  lastName: row.lastName,
+  email: row.email,
+  cellPhone: row.cellPhone,
+  landline: row.landline,
+  addressLine: row.addressLine,
+  city: row.city,
+  zip: row.zip,
+  outcome: row.outcome,
+  personId: row.personId,
+  isNewPerson: row.isNewPerson,
+  changedFields: row.changedFields,
+  candidates,
+  suggestedPersonId: row.suggestedPersonId,
+})
+
+const personKind = (row: {
+  personId: string | null
+  isNewPerson: boolean
+}): 'l2' | 'new' | 'none' =>
+  row.personId === null ? 'none' : row.isNewPerson ? 'new' : 'l2'
+
+@Injectable()
+export class ContactUploadsService extends createPrismaBase(
+  MODELS.ContactUpload,
+) {
+  constructor(
+    private readonly s3: S3Service,
+    private readonly queueProducer: QueueProducerService,
+    private readonly contacts: ContactsService,
+    private readonly voterQuery: VoterQueryService,
+    private readonly analytics: AnalyticsService,
+  ) {
+    super()
+  }
+
+  async createUpload(args: {
+    organization: Organization
+    userId: number
+    name: string
+    columnMapping: ContactUploadColumnMapping
+    fileName: string
+    file: Buffer
+  }): Promise<ContactUploadResponse> {
+    const { organization, columnMapping } = args
+    const rows = await parseContactUploadCsv(args.file, columnMapping)
+
+    const id = uuidv7()
+    const fileKey = `${organization.slug}/${id}.csv`
+    const bucket = process.env.CONTACT_UPLOADS_BUCKET
+    if (bucket) {
+      await this.s3.uploadFile(bucket, args.file, fileKey, {
+        contentType: MimeTypes.IMAGE_CSV,
+      })
+    } else {
+      this.logger.warn(
+        { uploadId: id },
+        'CONTACT_UPLOADS_BUCKET is not configured; not storing the original file',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const matchRows = rows.map((row) => ({
+      uploadId: id,
+      organizationSlug: organization.slug,
+      rowIndex: row.rowIndex,
+      firstName: row.firstName,
+      lastName: row.lastName,
+      email: row.email,
+      cellPhone: row.cellPhone,
+      landline: row.landline,
+      addressLine: row.addressLine,
+      city: row.city,
+      zip: row.zip,
+      outcome: row.hasName
+        ? ContactUploadMatchOutcome.pending
+        : ContactUploadMatchOutcome.invalid,
+    }))
+    const chunks: (typeof matchRows)[] = []
+    for (let start = 0; start < matchRows.length; start += INSERT_CHUNK_SIZE) {
+      chunks.push(matchRows.slice(start, start + INSERT_CHUNK_SIZE))
+    }
+    const [upload] = await this.client.$transaction([
+      this.model.create({
+        data: {
+          id,
+          organizationSlug: organization.slug,
+          userId: args.userId,
+          name: args.name,
+          fileName: args.fileName,
+          fileKey,
+          firstNameColumn: columnMapping.firstName,
+          lastNameColumn: columnMapping.lastName,
+          emailColumn: columnMapping.email,
+          cellPhoneColumn: columnMapping.cellPhone,
+          landlineColumn: columnMapping.landline,
+          addressLineColumn: columnMapping.addressLine,
+          cityColumn: columnMapping.city,
+          zipColumn: columnMapping.zip,
+          consentAffirmedAt: new Date(),
+          rowCount: rows.length,
+          invalidCount: rows.filter((row) => !row.hasName).length,
+        },
+        include: UPLOAD_USER_INCLUDE,
+      }),
+      ...chunks.map((data) =>
+        this.client.contactUploadMatch.createMany({ data }),
+      ),
+    ])
+
+    let enqueueFailed = false
+    try {
+      await this.queueProducer.sendMessage(
+        { type: QueueType.CONTACT_UPLOAD_MATCH, data: { uploadId: id } },
+        `${MessageGroup.contactUploadMatch}-${organization.slug}`,
+        {
+          throwOnError: true,
+          deduplicationId: `${QueueType.CONTACT_UPLOAD_MATCH}-${id}`,
+        },
+      )
+    } catch (err) {
+      this.logger.error({ err, uploadId: id }, 'contact upload enqueue failed')
+      enqueueFailed = true
+    }
+    if (enqueueFailed) {
+      await this.model.update({
+        where: { id },
+        data: {
+          status: ContactUploadStatus.failed,
+          failureReason: 'Matching could not be started',
+        },
+      })
+      throw new BadGatewayException('Could not start matching this upload')
+    }
+    return toUploadResponse(upload)
+  }
+
+  async listUploads(
+    organization: Organization,
+  ): Promise<ListContactUploadsResponse> {
+    const uploads = await this.model.findMany({
+      where: { organizationSlug: organization.slug },
+      orderBy: { createdAt: Prisma.SortOrder.desc },
+      include: UPLOAD_USER_INCLUDE,
+    })
+    return { uploads: uploads.map(toUploadResponse) }
+  }
+
+  async getUpload(
+    organization: Organization,
+    id: string,
+  ): Promise<ContactUploadResponse> {
+    return toUploadResponse(await this.findOwnedUpload(organization, id))
+  }
+
+  async listRows(
+    organization: Organization,
+    id: string,
+    query: ListContactUploadRowsInput,
+  ): Promise<ListContactUploadRowsResponse> {
+    await this.findOwnedUpload(organization, id)
+    const tokens = (query.search ?? '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
+    const where: Prisma.ContactUploadMatchWhereInput = {
+      uploadId: id,
+      outcome: { in: OUTCOMES_BY_FILTER[query.outcome] },
+      AND: tokens.map((token) => ({
+        OR: [
+          {
+            firstName: {
+              contains: token,
+              mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive,
+            },
+          },
+          {
+            lastName: { contains: token, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive },
+          },
+          { email: { contains: token, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
+        ],
+      })),
+    }
+    const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
+      this.client.contactUploadMatch.findMany({
+        where: {
+          ...where,
+          ...(query.cursor === undefined
+            ? {}
+            : { rowIndex: { gt: query.cursor } }),
+        },
+        orderBy: { rowIndex: Prisma.SortOrder.asc },
+        take: query.take + 1,
+      }),
+      this.client.contactUploadMatch.count({ where }),
+    ])
+    const page = rows.slice(0, query.take)
+    const lastRow = page[page.length - 1]
+    const candidatesById = await this.candidatesFor(
+      organization,
+      page.filter(
+        (row) => row.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.needs_input,
+      ),
+    )
+    return {
+      rows: page.map((row) =>
+        toRowResponse(
+          row,
+          row.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.needs_input
+            ? row.candidatePersonIds
+                .map((personId) => candidatesById.get(personId))
+                .filter(
+                  (candidate): candidate is ContactUploadCandidate =>
+                    candidate !== undefined,
+                )
+            : [],
+        ),
+      ),
+      nextCursor: rows.length > query.take && lastRow ? lastRow.rowIndex : null,
+      total,
+    }
+  }
+
+  async setRowMatch(args: {
+    organization: Organization
+    uploadId: string
+    rowId: string
+    userId: number
+    body: SetContactUploadRowMatch
+  }): Promise<ContactUploadResponse> {
+    const { organization, uploadId, rowId, userId, body } = args
+    const upload = await this.findOwnedUpload(organization, uploadId)
+    const row = await this.client.contactUploadMatch.findFirst({
+      where: { id: rowId, uploadId: upload.id },
+    })
+    if (!row) throw new NotFoundException('Upload row not found')
+    if (row.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.pending) {
+      throw new ConflictException('This row is still being matched')
+    }
+    if (row.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.invalid) {
+      throw new BadRequestException('This row has no name to match')
+    }
+
+    const target =
+      'skip' in body
+        ? { personId: null, isNewPerson: false }
+        : 'newPerson' in body
+          ? { personId: uuidv7(), isNewPerson: true }
+          : await this.resolvePickedPerson(
+              organization,
+              row,
+              body.personId.toLowerCase(),
+            )
+
+    const updated = await this.client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      await tx.contactUploadMatch.update({
+        where: { id: row.id },
+        data: {
+          personId: target.personId,
+          isNewPerson: target.isNewPerson,
+          outcome:
+            target.personId === null
+              ? ContactUploadMatchOutcome.skipped
+              : ContactUploadMatchOutcome.resolved,
+          method: ContactUploadMatchMethod.manual,
+          resolvedAt: new Date(),
+          resolvedByUserId: userId,
+        },
+      })
+      return this.recountAfterReview(tx, upload)
+    })
+
+    if (row.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.needs_input) {
+      void this.analytics
+        .track(userId, EVENTS.Contacts.AmbiguousRowResolved, {
+          resolution:
+            'skip' in body ? 'skipped' : 'newPerson' in body ? 'new' : 'person',
+          rowIndex: row.rowIndex,
+        })
+        .catch(() => undefined)
+    } else {
+      void this.analytics
+        .track(userId, EVENTS.Contacts.MatchChanged, {
+          from: personKind(row),
+          to: personKind(target),
+        })
+        .catch(() => undefined)
+    }
+    return toUploadResponse(updated)
+  }
+
+  async acceptSuggested(args: {
+    organization: Organization
+    uploadId: string
+    userId: number
+  }): Promise<AcceptSuggestedMatchesResponse> {
+    const upload = await this.findOwnedUpload(args.organization, args.uploadId)
+    const { accepted, updated } = await this.client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      const count = await tx.$executeRaw`
+          UPDATE contact_upload_match
+          SET person_id = suggested_person_id,
+              is_new_person = false,
+              outcome = 'resolved',
+              method = 'manual',
+              resolved_at = now(),
+              resolved_by_user_id = ${args.userId},
+              updated_at = now()
+          WHERE upload_id = ${upload.id}
+            AND outcome = 'needs_input'
+            AND suggested_person_id IS NOT NULL
+        `
+      return {
+        accepted: count,
+        updated: await this.recountAfterReview(tx, upload),
+      }
+    })
+    if (accepted > 0) {
+      void this.analytics
+        .track(args.userId, EVENTS.Contacts.AmbiguousRowResolved, {
+          resolution: 'acceptedSuggested',
+          rowCount: accepted,
+        })
+        .catch(() => undefined)
+    }
+    return { accepted, upload: toUploadResponse(updated) }
+  }
+
+  async retryUpload(
+    organization: Organization,
+    id: string,
+  ): Promise<ContactUploadResponse> {
+    await this.findOwnedUpload(organization, id)
+    const { count } = await this.model.updateMany({
+      where: { id, status: ContactUploadStatus.failed },
+      data: { status: ContactUploadStatus.processing, failureReason: null },
+    })
+    if (count === 0) {
+      throw new ConflictException('Only a failed upload can be retried')
+    }
+
+    let enqueueFailed = false
+    try {
+      await this.queueProducer.sendMessage(
+        { type: QueueType.CONTACT_UPLOAD_MATCH, data: { uploadId: id } },
+        `${MessageGroup.contactUploadMatch}-${organization.slug}`,
+        { throwOnError: true },
+      )
+    } catch (err) {
+      this.logger.error({ err, uploadId: id }, 'contact upload retry failed')
+      enqueueFailed = true
+    }
+    if (enqueueFailed) {
+      await this.model.update({
+        where: { id },
+        data: {
+          status: ContactUploadStatus.failed,
+          failureReason: 'Matching could not be started',
+        },
+      })
+      throw new BadGatewayException('Could not start matching this upload')
+    }
+    return this.getUpload(organization, id)
+  }
+
+  async countOutcomes(
+    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
+    uploadId: string,
+  ): Promise<ContactUploadCounts> {
+    const groups = await tx.$queryRaw<ContactUploadOutcomeGroup[]>`
+      SELECT outcome, is_new_person AS "isNewPerson", method,
+        cardinality(changed_fields) > 0 AS "hasChangedFields",
+        count(*)::int AS count
+      FROM contact_upload_match
+      WHERE upload_id = ${uploadId}
+      GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
+    `
+    return countsFromOutcomeGroups(groups)
+  }
+
+  private async recountAfterReview(
+    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
+    upload: ContactUpload,
+  ): Promise<ContactUploadWithUser> {
+    const counts = await this.countOutcomes(tx, upload.id)
+    const finished =
+      upload.status === ContactUploadStatus.needs_input &&
+      counts.needsInputCount === 0
+    return tx.contactUpload.update({
+      where: { id: upload.id },
+      data: {
+        ...counts,
+        ...(finished
+          ? { status: ContactUploadStatus.complete, completedAt: new Date() }
+          : {}),
+      },
+      include: UPLOAD_USER_INCLUDE,
+    })
+  }
+
+  // A stored candidate, or (Change match) anyone this org can open on the
+  // person panel. findPerson 404s an id the org cannot read.
+  private async resolvePickedPerson(
+    organization: Organization,
+    row: ContactUploadMatch,
+    personId: string,
+  ): Promise<{ personId: string; isNewPerson: boolean }> {
+    if (!row.candidatePersonIds.includes(personId)) {
+      await this.contacts.findPerson(personId, organization)
+    }
+    const minted = await this.client.contactUploadMatch.findFirst({
+      where: {
+        organizationSlug: organization.slug,
+        personId,
+        isNewPerson: true,
+      },
+      select: { id: true },
+    })
+    return { personId, isNewPerson: minted !== null }
+  }
+
+  private async candidatesFor(
+    organization: Organization,
+    rows: ContactUploadMatch[],
+  ): Promise<Map<string, ContactUploadCandidate>> {
+    const ids = [...new Set(rows.flatMap((row) => row.candidatePersonIds))]
+    if (ids.length === 0) return new Map()
+    const { districtId, dataset } =
+      await this.contacts.resolveEligibleDistrict(organization)
+    const { people } = await this.voterQuery.findPeople(
+      ListPeopleDTO.create({
+        districtId,
+        filters: { id: { in: ids } },
+        resultsPerPage: ids.length,
+        page: 1,
+        skipCount: true,
+      }),
+      dataset,
+    )
+    return new Map(
+      people.map((person) => [
+        person.id,
+        {
+          personId: person.id,
+          firstName: person.firstName,
+          lastName: person.lastName,
+          addressLine: person.address.line1,
+          city: person.address.city,
+          zip: person.address.zip,
+          age: person.age,
+        },
+      ]),
+    )
+  }
+
+  private async findOwnedUpload(
+    organization: Organization,
+    id: string,
+  ): Promise<ContactUploadWithUser> {
+    const upload = await this.model.findFirst({
+      where: { id, organizationSlug: organization.slug },
+      include: UPLOAD_USER_INCLUDE,
+    })
+    if (!upload) throw new NotFoundException('Upload not found')
+    return upload
+  }

+import {
+  ContactUploadMatchMethod,
+  ContactUploadMatchOutcome,
+} from '@/generated/prisma'
+
+export type ContactUploadOutcomeGroup = {
+  outcome: ContactUploadMatchOutcome
+  isNewPerson: boolean
+  method: ContactUploadMatchMethod | null
+  hasChangedFields: boolean
+  count: number
+}
+
+export type ContactUploadCounts = {
+  matchedCount: number
+  newCount: number
+  needsInputCount: number
+  skippedCount: number
+  invalidCount: number
+  updatedCount: number
+  unchangedCount: number
+}
+
+export const countsFromOutcomeGroups = (
+  groups: ContactUploadOutcomeGroup[],
+): ContactUploadCounts => {
+  const count = (test: (group: ContactUploadOutcomeGroup) => boolean): number =>
+    groups.filter(test).reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.count, 0)
+  return {
+    matchedCount: count(
+      (g) =>
+        g.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.matched ||
+        (g.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.resolved && !g.isNewPerson),
+    ),
+    newCount: count(
+      (g) =>
+        g.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.new ||
+        (g.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.resolved && g.isNewPerson),
+    ),
+    needsInputCount: count(
+      (g) => g.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.needs_input,
+    ),
+    skippedCount: count((g) => g.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.skipped),
+    invalidCount: count((g) => g.outcome === ContactUploadMatchOutcome.invalid),
+    updatedCount: count((g) => g.hasChangedFields),
+    unchangedCount: count(
+      (g) =>
+        g.method === ContactUploadMatchMethod.prior_upload &&
+        !g.hasChangedFields,
+    ),
+  }
+}

+import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common'
+import csvParser from 'csv-parser'
+import { Readable } from 'stream'
+import {
+  CONTACT_UPLOAD_MAX_ROWS,
+  EmailSchema,
+  type ContactUploadColumnMapping,
+} from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+
+export type ParsedContactUploadRow = {
+  rowIndex: number
+  firstName: string | null
+  lastName: string | null
+  email: string | null
+  cellPhone: string | null
+  landline: string | null
+  addressLine: string | null
+  city: string | null
+  zip: string | null
+  hasName: boolean
+}
+
+const normalizeHeader = (header: string): string =>
+  header.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim()
+
+const blankToNull = (value: string | undefined): string | null => {
+  const trimmed = value?.trim() ?? ''
+  return trimmed === '' ? null : trimmed
+}
+
+export const normalizeEmail = (value: string | null): string | null => {
+  if (value === null) return null
+  const lowered = value.toLowerCase()
+  return EmailSchema.safeParse(lowered).success ? lowered : null
+}
+
+// The L2 format every outreach channel already reads. NANP area codes and
+// exchanges never start with 0 or 1.
+export const normalizePhone = (value: string | null): string | null => {
+  if (value === null) return null
+  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '')
+  const local =
+    digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('1') ? digits.slice(1) : digits
+  if (!/^[2-9]\d{2}[2-9]\d{6}$/.test(local)) return null
+  return `(${local.slice(0, 3)}) ${local.slice(3, 6)}-${local.slice(6)}`
+}
+
+// Excel drops a ZIP's leading zeros, so a 3 or 4 digit value is padded back.
+export const normalizeZip = (value: string | null): string | null => {
+  if (value === null) return null
+  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '')
+  if (digits.length === 5 || digits.length === 9) return digits.slice(0, 5)
+  if (digits.length === 3 || digits.length === 4) {
+    return digits.padStart(5, '0')
+  }
+  return null
+}
+
+export const parseContactUploadCsv = async (
+  file: Buffer,
+  mapping: ContactUploadColumnMapping,
+): Promise<ParsedContactUploadRow[]> => {
+  const rows: ParsedContactUploadRow[] = []
+  let headers: string[] = []
+  const stream = Readable.from(file).pipe(
+    csvParser({
+      mapHeaders: ({ header }) => normalizeHeader(header),
+    }),
+  )
+  stream.on('headers', (parsed: string[]) => {
+    headers = parsed
+  })
+
+  const column = (header: string | null): string | null =>
+    header === null ? null : normalizeHeader(header)
+  const columns = {
+    firstName: column(mapping.firstName),
+    lastName: column(mapping.lastName),
+    email: column(mapping.email),
+    cellPhone: column(mapping.cellPhone),
+    landline: column(mapping.landline),
+    addressLine: column(mapping.addressLine),
+    city: column(mapping.city),
+    zip: column(mapping.zip),
+  }
+
+  try {
+    const records: AsyncIterable<Record<string, string>> = stream
+    for await (const record of records) {
+      if (rows.length >= CONTACT_UPLOAD_MAX_ROWS) {
+        throw new BadRequestException(
+          `The file has more than ${CONTACT_UPLOAD_MAX_ROWS} rows`,
+        )
+      }
+      const read = (header: string | null): string | null =>
+        header === null ? null : blankToNull(record[header])
+      const firstName = read(columns.firstName)
+      const lastName = read(columns.lastName)
+      rows.push({
+        rowIndex: rows.length,
+        firstName,
+        lastName,
+        email: normalizeEmail(read(columns.email)),
+        cellPhone: normalizePhone(read(columns.cellPhone)),
+        landline: normalizePhone(read(columns.landline)),
+        addressLine: read(columns.addressLine),
+        city: read(columns.city),
+        zip: normalizeZip(read(columns.zip)),
+        hasName: firstName !== null && lastName !== null,
+      })
+    }
+  } finally {
+    stream.destroy()
+  }
+
+  const missing = Object.values(columns).filter(
+    (header): header is string => header !== null && !headers.includes(header),
+  )
+  if (missing.length > 0) {
+    throw new BadRequestException(
+      `The file has no column named ${missing.map((h) => `"${h}"`).join(', ')}`,
+    )
+  }
+  if (rows.length === 0) {
+    throw new BadRequestException('The file has no rows')
+  }
+  return rows
+}

+import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
+import type {
+  ContactUploadColumnMapping,
+  ListContactUploadsResponse,
+  SetContactUploadRowMatch,
+} from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { clientRequest } from 'gpApi/typed-request'
+import { useOrganization } from '@shared/organization-picker'
+
+export const contactUploadsKey = (orgSlug: string | undefined) => [
+  'contact-uploads',
+  orgSlug,
+]
+
+export const contactUploadKey = (
+  orgSlug: string | undefined,
+  uploadId: string,
+) => ['contact-uploads', orgSlug, uploadId]
+
+export const contactUploadRowsKey = (
+  orgSlug: string | undefined,
+  uploadId: string,
+) => ['contact-uploads', orgSlug, uploadId, 'rows']
+
+export const contactSourcesKey = (
+  orgSlug: string | undefined,
+  personId: string,
+) => ['contact-sources', orgSlug, personId]
+
+const POLL_MS = 3000
+
+// Polls while any upload is still matching, so a row flips from Processing
+// without a refresh.
+export const useContactUploads = (enabled = true) => {
+  const orgSlug = useOrganization()?.slug
+  return useQuery({
+    queryKey: contactUploadsKey(orgSlug),
+    queryFn: async (): Promise<ListContactUploadsResponse> =>
+      (await clientRequest('GET /v1/contact-uploads', {})).data,
+    enabled,
+    refetchInterval: (query) =>
+      query.state.data?.uploads.some((upload) => upload.status === 'processing')
+        ? POLL_MS
+        : false,
+  })
+}
+
+export const useContactUpload = (uploadId: string) => {
+  const orgSlug = useOrganization()?.slug
+  return useQuery({
+    queryKey: contactUploadKey(orgSlug, uploadId),
+    queryFn: async () =>
+      (await clientRequest('GET /v1/contact-uploads/:id', { id: uploadId }))
+        .data,
+    refetchInterval: (query) =>
+      query.state.data?.status === 'processing' ? POLL_MS : false,
+  })
+}
+
+export const useContactSources = (personId: string | null, enabled = true) => {
+  const orgSlug = useOrganization()?.slug
+  return useQuery({
+    queryKey: contactSourcesKey(orgSlug, personId ?? ''),
+    queryFn: async () =>
+      (
+        await clientRequest('GET /v1/contacts/:personId/sources', {
+          personId: personId!,
+        })
+      ).data,
+    enabled: enabled && Boolean(personId),
+  })
+}
+
+export const createContactUpload = async ({
+  file,
+  name,
+  columnMapping,
+}: {
+  file: File
+  name: string
+  columnMapping: ContactUploadColumnMapping
+}) => {
+  const body = new FormData()
+  body.append('name', name)
+  body.append('consentAffirmed', 'true')
+  body.append('columnMapping', JSON.stringify(columnMapping))
+  body.append('file', file)
+  return (await clientRequest('POST /v1/contact-uploads', {}, { body })).data
+}
+
+export const setContactUploadRowMatch = async (
+  uploadId: string,
+  rowId: string,
+  match: SetContactUploadRowMatch,
+) =>
+  (
+    await clientRequest('PUT /v1/contact-uploads/:id/rows/:rowId/match', {
+      id: uploadId,
+      rowId,
+      ...match,
+    })
+  ).data
